details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:393-395,419 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: AI_ENGINE_CLAUDE_NO_WEB_NOTE, appended to every Claude system prompt, still says web search and web fetch are unavailable and tells the model not to try them, although the PR enables WebSearch.
  WHY: The model is told not to use a tool it has been given, so the feature is inert; tests/test_ai_engine.py:331 pins the stale text. Severity disagreement: sonnet and openai said MAJOR, gemini, minimax and qwen said BLOCKER, so the highest is used.
- prompts/mode-plan.txt:174, prompts/mode-clarify.txt:38, prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt:22, prompts/_templates twins, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:231, .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1538 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The planner, clarify and orchestrate prompts still tell Claude runs that web search is unavailable.
  WHY: Claude runs are steered away from the new search tool and toward escalation or BLOCKED, which recreates the original failure.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:112-114 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: _is_allowed_web_search_tool accepts a web search tool with no max_uses, so the documented 1-8 bound is not enforced.
  WHY: The tool is forwarded with no relay-enforced cap, and tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py accepts that shape. Severity disagreement: sonnet and openai said NIT, the others said MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:120-123 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: WEB_SEARCH_DOMAIN_RE.match and WEB_SEARCH_PROFILE_RE.match are used instead of fullmatch, so a trailing newline passes.
  WHY: Inputs such as "a.com\n" pass validation. Severity disagreement: gemini said MAJOR, while sonnet and minimax raised it only as a hardening suggestion (risk score 1).
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:759-770 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A project that stage_nested_node skips because its manifest read fails still uses one of the MAX_NESTED_NODE_PROJECTS slots that find_nested_node_projects filled.
  WHY: Fewer projects are staged than the quota allows, and the log shows nested_over_limit=0 with no skip message.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:818-822 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: handoff_nested_deps calls os.rename without error handling, so an OSError propagates and aborts the loop.
  WHY: Later projects lose their hand-off. The shell caller only warns. Severity disagreement: gemini said MAJOR in one entry, while the others said NIT.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:420-429 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The nested npm install loop runs before the pip and pytest installs inside the shared 900 s container budget.
  WHY: Slow nested installs can starve the Python dependency installs and leave validations unverified. Severity disagreement: sonnet said NIT, the others said MAJOR.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:795-823 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: handoff_nested_deps skips an entry with no log line when the source is a symlink or not a directory, and checks only the last path component for a symlink.
  WHY: A missing install cannot be told apart from an unstaged one, and a swapped directory could move an unexpected host directory (hardening suggestions 2 and 3).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Claude gets model-side web search, every phase including implement (Q4:A, Q6:B); the Claude-facing instructions must say so.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh (AI_ENGINE_CLAUDE_NO_WEB_NOTE), prompts/mode-plan.txt, prompts/mode-clarify.txt, prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt and their _templates twins, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, .github/workflows/clarify.yml, tests/test_ai_engine.py:331
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: None of these files has a hunk correcting the "no web search" text, and scripts/ai_engine.sh is touched only at lines 473-482, 525-531, 538-545 and 551-557. The prompts still say Claude runs have no web search, and tests/test_ai_engine.py:331 pins the stale text.
- requirement: Docs are consistent with the new default (agents.md corrected, new web_search key in claude_engine.json).
  expected_change_site: README.md:2755 (claude_engine.json table row) and README.md:2815-2824 (Tool profiles)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: README.md is not in the PR diff, line 2821 still lists WebFetch as available, and the line 2755 row does not mention web_search.
- requirement: The new helpers (stage_nested_node, find_nested_node_projects, handoff_nested_deps) and the handoff-nested-deps subcommand should be registered.
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md and the scripts registry
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in docs/INVENTORY.md or any registry file appears in the PR diff.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:_is_allowed_web_search_tool (max_uses check) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A web search tool with no max_uses passes, so the documented 1-8 bound is enforced only when the client sends the field.
  WHY: A request that omits max_uses is forwarded with no relay-enforced cap; the test accepts the omission.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:393-395,419 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: AI_ENGINE_CLAUDE_NO_WEB_NOTE still says web search and fetch are unavailable, while the PR adds WebSearch.
  WHY: The tool is exposed but the instructions forbid it; the note ignores the web_search switch and tests/test_ai_engine.py:331 asserts the stale sentence.
- prompts/mode-plan.txt:174, prompts/mode-clarify.txt:38, prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt:22, their _templates twins, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:231, .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1538 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The planner, clarify and orchestrate prompts still say Claude runs have no web search.
  WHY: Claude runs are steered away from the search tool and toward BLOCKED, which recreates the failure the PR set out to remove.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:handoff_nested_deps (os.rename) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The os.rename call is unguarded, so an OSError is not caught.
  WHY: A cross-device move is unlikely; the shell caller turns it into a warning and no nested dependencies.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:find_nested_node_projects | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A project whose manifest read fails later still takes one of the 6 slots.
  WHY: A qualifying project can be dropped silently while nested_over_limit=0 is logged; the case is rare.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:nested install loop | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Up to 6 nested npm installs run before the pip and pytest installs inside the single 900 s budget.
  WHY: A slow nested install can time out the container and leave the Python dependencies uninstalled.
- HARDENING: claude_anthropic_relay.py _is_allowed_web_search_tool: reject the tool when max_uses is None or outside 1..8 (risk 1). WEB_SEARCH_DOMAIN_RE and WEB_SEARCH_PROFILE_RE: use fullmatch because $ matches before a trailing newline (risk 1).
- TASK_GAP: Requirement "Claude gets model-side web search… Q6:B: every phase, implement included."
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh (AI_ENGINE_CLAUDE_NO_WEB_NOTE), prompts/mode-plan.txt, prompts/mode-clarify.txt, prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt and their _templates twins, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, .github/workflows/clarify.yml, tests/test_ai_engine.py:331
  Evidence of absence: None of these files has a hunk correcting the "no web search" text; scripts/ai_engine.sh is touched only at 473–482, 525–531, 538–545 and 551–557.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: docs consistent with the new default (agents.md corrected, new web_search key in claude_engine.json).
  Expected change site: README.md Claude tools description and the claude_engine.json table row.
  Evidence of absence: README.md is not in the PR diff; the reviewer did not read it, so the cited line numbers are unverified.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:120 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _is_allowed_web_search_tool allows missing fields and does not enforce max_uses.
  WHY: Search tools are forwarded without the 1-8 limit.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:120 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: .match() is used instead of .fullmatch() for WEB_SEARCH_DOMAIN_RE and WEB_SEARCH_PROFILE_RE.
  WHY: Strings such as "allowed.com\nmalicious.com" could pass.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:419 (AI_ENGINE_CLAUDE_NO_WEB_NOTE) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The instruction block says web search and fetch are unavailable and tells the model not to try them.
  WHY: The model will not use the new tool, so the feature is inert.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:759-770 (stage_nested_node) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: stage_nested_node skips a project whose manifest read fails without freeing its quota slot.
  WHY: Fewer projects are staged than the quota allows.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:818 (handoff_nested_deps) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: os.rename has no fallback for cross-filesystem moves.
  WHY: A cross-device move raises OSError and the hand-off fails entirely.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:420-429 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The nested Node install loop runs before the pip and pytest installs inside the 900 s budget.
  WHY: Slow npm installs can starve the Python installs and leave the sandbox unverified.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:818 (handoff_nested_deps) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: os.rename follows only an exists check, with no handling of failures at rename time.
  WHY: An OSError can leave a partial transfer if multiple projects were listed.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Claude gets model-side web search ... every phase, implement included" (Q4:A, Q6:B); the Claude-facing instructions must say so.
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-plan.txt, prompts/mode-clarify.txt, prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt, the prompts/_templates twins, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, .github/workflows/clarify.yml
  Evidence of absence: None of these files is in the PR diff; they still say Claude runs have no web search, and the planner prompt's "when a web tool is available" condition will read as false.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: docs correction (agents.md corrected to "No profile has WebFetch"; web_search key added to claude_engine.json).
  Expected change site: README.md:2820-2821 and the README.md:2755 table row
  Evidence of absence: README.md is not in the PR; line 2821 still lists WebFetch and the line 2755 row does not mention web_search.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Re
